_note: Read live by the app, a small area at a time, straight from each city. Never copied into packs: most of these carry no license that allows redistribution. {n}{s}{e}{w} are the query box.

drains.note: County only: no inlets inside the City of Sacramento

reports.where: CategoryName IN ('Drains Plugged Drain Inlet','Drains Drain Inlet Foreign Material','Drains General')

request_reason in('Catch Basin Not Draining','Catch Basin - Clogged','Street Flooding','Catch Basin Clogged','Street Flooding / Drainage') AND latitude between {s} and {n} AND longitude between {w} and {e}
Subject IN ('Flooding or Drainage Issue','Storm Flood or Drainage - City of Miami') AND Latitude BETWEEN {s} AND {n} AND Longitude BETWEEN {w} AND {e}

drains.where: GENERAL_TY IN ('Catch Basin','Drop Inlet','Yard Basin','Gutter Basin')

reports.where: upper(event_type) like '%FLOOD%' AND latitude between {s} and {n} AND longitude between {w} and {e}

drains.where: INLETTYPE IS NOT NULL AND INLETTYPE <> 'Pipe'

reports.where: CASE_TYPE IN ('Flooding','Poor Drainage','Inlet Clogged Needs Cleaning ROW')

descriptor in('Catch Basin Clogged/Flooding (Use Comments) (SC)','Street Flooding (SJ)','Highway Flooding (SH)','Catch Basin Clogged','Flooding on Street','Flooding on Highway') AND within_box(location,{n},{w},{s},{e})
